Showed the current requested screen orientation in the notification and button.
Supported external changes to screen orientation.
Decremented version number for release.
Added launcher icon and store listing images.
Removed redundant flags on the floating button view.
Made the floating button semitransparent.
Coloured the notification in Android 5.
Made the button's position be persisted.
Stopped saving the button's position on screen orientation change since it was redundant.
Removed knowledge of screen orientation from FloatingButton.
Simplified code.
Moved PersistedState initialisation inside FloatingButton.
Consolidated duplicate logic.
Made the button's position be correctly restored on app restart.
Moved service-specific code into its own package.
Made the service automatically restart after crashing or being killed.
Retained the service enabled and running states across restarts, crashes and updates.
Made the "Enabled" switch on the main screen bigger.
Incremented version number for release
Enabled resource shrinking. Disabled obfuscation.
Made hiding the button also remove it so the OS can reclaim the ~7MB of RAM if it chooses.
Restricted to devices that support both portrait and landscape.
Hid notification timestamp.
Fixed bugs with dragging the floating button.
Fixed bug that caused the button's position to not be saved when a drag is canceled.
Fixed crash on external screen rotation change while button hidden.
Split floating button management logic into its own class.
Hid the notification from the lock screen.
Incremented version numbers for release. Updated store listing screenshots.
Upgraded to Android Studio 1.5.
Made long-pressing the button hide it.
Added support for "float" type settings.
Switched to common library settings.
Ignored thumbs.db file.
Added a bit of documentation.
Added basic notification button.
Added "toggle screen orientation" notification button.
Added icons missing in last commit.
Restored system auto rotation state when this application is disabled.

Incremented version numbers for release.
Fixed Groovy errors in the project's build script.
Replaced PNG drawables with vector drawables.
Unversioned the .xml and gradle.xml files.
Fixed typo in gitignore.
